text.en: Dog owners emphasize how happy and relaxed their pets remain during and after grooming sessions at the salon. Reviewers note that the groomers clearly love animals, taking special care to reassure nervous pets and returning them happy with decorative ribbon touches.

Clients speak warmly of the friendly and accommodating attitude shown by Michelle and her team on Woodhill Road. Reviewers appreciate that staff are pleasant, provide helpful updates on how pets behaved, and gladly accommodate short-notice wash and dry requests.

Pet parents report excellent styling outcomes, noting that their dogs look handsome and smell wonderful after full grooms. Customers praise the precision of the cuts and trims, with several owners rebooking immediately after seeing the tidy post-groom results.

q.en: Can the salon accommodate short-notice dog washes?

a.en: Yes, clients report that the team has accommodated drop-ins for quick bath and dry services when dogs get muddy.

q.en: Do groomers provide feedback on how pets behaved?

a.en: Yes, reviewers appreciate that the staff share detailed feedback about how their dogs managed during the groom.

q.en: Are decorative bows or ribbons included after grooming?

a.en: Yes, multiple clients mention that their dogs return looking lovely with a small finishing ribbon or bow.

q.en: How long does a routine wash and dry take?

a.en: Reviewers note that a quick wash and dry for larger breeds like Labradors was completed in around 30 minutes.
